parts.title: Shared activities
questions: What activity do you like doing with a small group?
How do you usually agree on a time to meet?
What happens when people in a group want different things?

parts.title: Individual talk
parts.cue: Describe a group activity you helped to organise.
questions: Say who the activity was for.
Explain what you were responsible for.
Describe a difficulty that the group faced.
Explain how the activity turned out.

parts.title: Discussion
questions: How should a group distribute work that is easy to overlook?
Why can an activity be convenient to organise but hard for some people to attend?
How do small and large groups make decisions differently?
What should count as success for a community activity?
